description: This file is a Node.js script for managing a workspace of multiple packages, including versioning, consistency checks, and package file operations. It defines classes for packages and workspace management, and includes CLI command handling.

classes.name: PWPackage
classes.description: Represents a package in the workspace, including its name, path, files, and package.json data.

classes.name: Workspace
classes.description: Manages a collection of packages, handles versioning, consistency, and file operations within the workspace.

methods.name: readJSON
methods.description: Asynchronously reads a JSON file and parses its content.

methods.name: writeJSON
methods.description: Asynchronously writes a JSON object to a file.

methods.name: PWPackage.constructor
methods.description: Initializes a package object with its descriptor data.

methods.name: Workspace.constructor
methods.description: Initializes a workspace with root directory and packages.

methods.name: Workspace.packages
methods.description: Returns the list of packages in the workspace.

methods.name: Workspace.version
methods.description: Retrieves the current workspace version from package.json.

methods.name: Workspace.setVersion
methods.description: Sets a new version for the workspace and updates all packages accordingly.

methods.name: Workspace.ensureConsistent
methods.description: Ensures workspace consistency by updating package files and lockfiles.
